part.text:
Confirmed — those failures pre-exist and are unrelated. The fix is complete.

**Change** in `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonWriter.java:494`: `value(double)` now only rejects NaN/infinite values when not in lenient mode, matching the behavior of `value(Number)`:

```java
if (!lenient && (Double.isNaN(value) || Double.isInfinite(value))) {
```

Validation: `JsonWriterTest` passes (39/39), including `testNonFiniteDoublesWhenLenient`. The remaining full-suite failures are pre-existing JDK date-format/locale issues, verified identical without the patch.
